correctness.rationale: For every integer k>=1 and F=Q or F_p for odd p>k, stabilizers under O(2) have order <=2k, hence prime-to-characteristic. A finite gap-stratification bounds the orbit dimension by k-1 and justifies Borel-to-orbit cohomology comparison. Tuffley Theorem 4 gives E_k an integral odd-sphere homotopy type; the only possible rotation-Borel transgression must be nonzero or the polynomial base would force unbounded-degree cohomology. Thus the rotation quotient ring is F[u]/(u^ceil(k/2)), degree u=2. Reflection sends u to -u. Averaging invariants yields F[v]/v^ceil(k/4), degree v=4, with v the Pontryagin class image. Naturality and universal coefficients prove compatibility and the large-prime torsion bound. A separate exact dihedral gap-cycle Euler calculation matches through k=100, and an all-k cancellation proof is supplied. Limits: no assertion of integral small-prime homotopy or torsion.

value.rationale: A natural complete rational and large-odd-prime ring classification of compact moduli of all nonempty bounded finite subsets of a circle under its entire isometry group. It identifies the sharp first positive-degree characteristic class at cardinality five, repeats it every four cardinalities, proves persistence of a geometric Pontryagin class, and excludes large-prime integral torsion. The gap-stratum Euler count offers a separate combinatorial explanation. This is a motivated infinite family with a complete algebra invariant, not an arbitrary finite calculation or mere parameter substitution.
